verdict.cause: pod evicted because its node was under resource pressure
verdict.meaning: this pod was killed to protect a machine running low on memory, usually because it asked for less than it actually uses
verdict.fix: set or raise the memory request for {workload} so the scheduler reserves what it uses

signatures.text: The node was low on resource: memory. Container reporter was using 512Mi, which exceeds its request of 200Mi.

records.body: The node was low on resource: memory. Container reporter was using 512Mi, which exceeds its request of 200Mi.

verdict.cause: volume mount failed; a referenced configmap or secret is likely missing
verdict.meaning: the pod is waiting for a configmap or secret that does not exist, so it cannot start until that config is created
verdict.fix: create the missing configmap or secret, or fix its name in the pod spec

signatures.text: MountVolume.SetUp failed for volume "config" : configmap "checkout-service-config" not found

verdict.cause: readiness probe failing; the pod is being kept out of service
verdict.meaning: the application is running but not answering its health check, so it is being kept out of the load balancer and serving no traffic
verdict.fix: confirm the probe path exists in the new image: kubectl rollout history deploy/{workload} -n {namespace}
